name: Amashi, Master of Flame
desc:
Amashi is a Vesperian NPC who acts as both progression for the Silentheart Oath and the Flamecharm trainer.

In order to obtain Flamecharm, you must bring five Dying Embers to Amashi (2 if you have already obtained Flamecharm on a previous character). Alternatively, if you have obtained the Silentheart Oath, you must kill them in order to get one of five Oath Talents.
